items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think he was a Johnson or Lincoln. Which was it? I forget. I don't know. He was a Lincoln. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He was around there. All these people were downtown.

ctx.x: Lincoln, uh, what you mean Lincoln and Lincoln?

Lincoln and, uh, Lincoln Park? What is it? Johnson Park. How far? Johnson Park was here and Lincoln Park. Just in your neighborhood? Lincoln Park was in one square and Johnson Park in this square right there where all them houses.
